title: Enforcement action response v1
description: Success reply of POST /v1/actions (201 fresh, 200 replayed) and of the GET/DELETE action routes. The evidence object is what Vigil's mark_executed stores verbatim; a drop counter that ticks is the proof of enforcement.

state.description: enforced = kernel state is live; released = the entry has been removed (TTL expiry or explicit release).

attach_point.description: Where the program is attached, e.g. 'eth0/xdp' or 'cgroup/vigil'.

map.description: Pinned map path holding the enforcement entry, e.g. /sys/fs/bpf/vigil/xdp_block_v1.

map_slot.description: Slot/index the entry landed in — pairs with the map path to make the kernel state inspectable.

counters.description: Data-path counters at enforcement time. Required on every success reply: evidence without counters is a faked success.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant after which the kernel entry self-expires (expiry lives in the map values, so containment ages out even if Vigil disappears).

replayed.description: True when this reply is the idempotent answer to a duplicate delivery: same evidence, no second enforcement.

released_at.description: Present on released actions: when the kernel state was removed.
